scope.flow: BuilderWallet initialization and sweep of held ERC20 tokens
scope.environment: Deployed BuilderWallet contract created by BuilderFactory, holding ERC20 tokens
evidence: BuilderWallet `init()` is permissionless and can be re-run to seize admin and steal funds
## H-01 — BuilderWallet `init()` is permissionless and can be re-run to seize admin and steal funds
Any unprivileged attacker can become `builderAdmin` for any deployed BuilderWallet and steal all ERC20 tokens held by that wallet (e.g., builder fee/commission receipts).
- A BuilderWallet exists (deployed by BuilderFactory) and holds ERC20 tokens.
1. Call `BuilderWallet.init(attacker)`.
2. Call `BuilderWallet.sweep(token, attacker)` for each token held.
- Unrestricted re-initialization: `https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/fe557748210a529ae414d7c487b6514be0d9e220/contracts/RiskEngine.sol#L2315`
- Sweep gated only by `builderAdmin`: `https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/fe557748210a529ae414d7c487b6514be0d9e220/contracts/RiskEngine.sol#L2319`

- Factory deploys wallet then calls `init` once (but does not prevent later calls): `https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-12-panoptic/blob/fe557748210a529ae414d7c487b6514be0d9e220/contracts/RiskEngine.sol#L2371`
